posts.title: Mission 52 Updates
posts.description: 1524 – Mark is safely on the gound! YAY. That’s a wrap! Thank you all for your interest and support! 73! Steve K6WW 1645 – Mark is on board and heading to 13,000 feet. Look for him on air about 1700. 1622 – Mark is suited up and manifested for a caravan departing at 1645. […]

posts.title: Mission 52 update!
posts.description: Mission 52 is scheduled for October 17 in conjunction with Pacificon. Make a contact with a skydiver and receive a one-of-a-kind QSL card.
